tool.name: Call window haplotypes
tool.description: read whole haplotypes off spanning reads and name them by their own content
tool.command: @REF_RESOLVE@ ## The specimen id becomes column 1 of the calls and the row id of the sheet, so it ## defaults to the collection element identifier rather than a dataset number. #set $eid = str($input.element_identifier) #if $eid.endswith('.bam') #set $eid = $eid.rsplit('.bam', 1)[0] #end if #if $specimen and str($specimen).strip() #set $spec = str($specimen).strip() #else #set $spec = $eid #end if ln -s '$input' 'input.bam' && ln -s '${input.metadata.bam_index}' 'input.bam.bai' && pyeuk call-haplotypes --bam 'input.bam' --ref '$ref_path' --specimen '$spec' --bed '$windows' --min-span $gates.min_span --min-reads $gates.min_reads --min-freq $gates.min_freq --denoise-edits $gates.denoise_edits --denoise-ratio $gates.denoise_ratio --out '$calls'

expand.label: Reference the BAM was aligned to
expand.help: The reference the BAM was mapped to: a FASTA from your history, or a genome cached on this Galaxy.

param.name: windows
param.label: Windows
param.help: From 'Define haplotype windows'. Must be the same windows for every specimen.

param.name: specimen
param.label: Specimen id
param.help: Leave blank to use the collection element identifier.

param.label: Minimum spanning reads for the window
param.help: Minimum fully-spanning reads before a window is called at all. Applied before any haplotype; harder on mixtures, which split reads between genotypes.

param.label: Minimum haplotype frequency
param.help: Minimum haplotype frequency: the fraction of spanning reads carrying the whole string. Per haplotype, not per site.

param.label: Denoise: fold strings within this many differing positions
param.help: Fold a haplotype into an abundant neighbour within this many differing positions, removing sequencing-error strings. 0 disables.

param.label: Denoise: abundance ratio required of the neighbour
param.help: Abundance ratio the neighbour must exceed before a string is folded into it.

tool.help:
Extracts, normalises, and filters single-molecule microhaplotypes across the defined windows for one specimen. Only reads that cover every base of a window are used, so each haplotype is one physically phased observation on a single molecule, not an inference across reads.
For each specimen and window the caller: (1) selects reads spanning the whole window, (2) left-aligns every gap to its leftmost equivalent position so that alternative alignments of the same insertion or deletion collapse into one tally, (3) counts exact sequence occurrences, (4) removes a haplotype if a 1-bp neighbour is at least denoise_ratio times more abundant (putative sequencing error or PCR chimera), (5) applies the three filters below, and (6) writes one record per surviving haplotype.
Filters:
* ``min_span`` -- spanning reads required before a window is called at all (default 30). * ``min_reads`` -- reads that must carry one haplotype (default 10). * ``min_freq`` -- fraction of spanning reads that must carry one haplotype (default 0.05).
A surviving haplotype is named by its 1-based reference differences (for example ``45T>A,57T>C``) or ``=`` for reference identity. If none passes, the locus is recorded as NOT_CALLED with its spanning depth, so failed specimens are preserved downstream rather than dropped: a spanning depth below min_span means uncalled, at or above means evaluated but filtered. @HELP_FOOTER@
